view/item/context.when: view == mdait.status && (viewItem == mdaitFileTarget || viewItem == mdaitFileTargetComplete || viewItem == mdaitPlainFileTarget || viewItem == mdaitPlainFileTargetComplete)

languageModelTools.name: mdait_getStatus
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the current translation status of the mdait-managed Markdown documents in the workspace. Returns a JSON envelope { schemaVersion, ok, summary, data, nextActions } where data contains total/translated/error unit counts and a breakdown of need flags (translate/revise/review/verify-deletion/keep). Pass detail:true to include a per-file breakdown of files that still need work. Read-only and free to call repeatedly; use it to observe state between other mdait tool calls and follow nextActions to reach the fully-translated steady state.

path.description: Optional file or directory path to scope the status. If omitted, returns workspace-wide status.

detail.description: If true, include per-file need breakdown (only files that still need work are listed).

languageModelTools.name: mdait_sync
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Synchronize translation markers in mdait-managed Markdown documents. Detects changes in source documents and updates need flags (need:translate or need:revise@{oldhash}) in target documents. This modifies files by updating HTML comment markers. Pass adopt:true ONLY when onboarding an existing bilingual site whose target files already contain translations but no mdait markers: matched existing translations are adopted with need:review instead of need:translate so they are never overwritten by translation. Returns a JSON envelope { schemaVersion, ok, summary, data, nextActions } where data contains processed file counts, unit-level change counts (added/modified/deleted/revisionsNeeded/adopted/kept), and the post-sync status breakdown. mdait commands are idempotent: re-running sync on an unchanged workspace reports zero changes.

adopt.description: One-time onboarding mode for existing bilingual sites. Adopts marker-less target units that already have content: establishes the from link and flags them need:review instead of need:translate, so existing translations are never overwritten.

align.description: AI-assisted alignment, only effective together with adopt:true. Before adoption, an LLM audits the position-based source-to-target unit mapping (heading skeletons + digests) and corrects mis-pairings caused by inserted/removed/reordered sections. Deterministic position-based mapping is always the fallback; adopted pairs stay need:review. Uses AI and shows a confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: mdait_translate
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Translate mdait-managed target files using AI. Accepts a single target file or a directory (translates every target file under it, sequentially, with one confirmation for the whole scope). Only units flagged need:translate or need:revise are processed; already-translated units are skipped, so re-running after a failure or cancellation resumes the remaining work. Uses diff-aware revision for changed content to preserve existing translations. Returns a JSON envelope { schemaVersion, ok, summary, data, nextActions } where data lists per-file success/failure with error causes and the remaining need breakdown for the scope.

path.description: Path of the target Markdown file or a directory containing target files to translate.

languageModelTools.name: mdait_term
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Manage the mdait glossary (terms file) using AI. action:"detect" extracts important terms from source documents (and their translations when available) and adds them to the glossary. action:"expand" resolves target-language translations for terms that lack them, using existing translated documents. Pass an optional path (file or directory) to scope the operation; omit it to process all translation pairs. Returns a JSON envelope { schemaVersion, ok, summary, data, nextActions } where data lists per-pair new/expanded term counts and the remaining unexpanded count. Idempotent: re-running detect/expand on unchanged content reports zero additions. For onboarding an existing bilingual site, run detect and expand BEFORE translating so new translations follow the established terminology.

action.description: "detect": extract new glossary terms from source content. "expand": resolve target-language terms for unexpanded glossary entries.

path.description: Optional file or directory to scope the operation. Source or target paths are both accepted. Omit to process all translation pairs.

languageModelTools.name: mdait_tm
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Manage the mdait translation memory (translations.tmx). action:"commit" registers sentence pairs from translated units (units with a from link and no need flag) using AI sentence alignment; units that still have need flags are skipped and reported in data.skipped with reasons, so resolve translation/review first. action:"optimize" recomputes TM entry weights from current source content (no AI). Pass an optional path (target file or directory) to scope a commit; omit it to commit all translation pairs. Returns a JSON envelope { schemaVersion, ok, summary, data, nextActions } where data contains new/updated entry counts and the skip-reason breakdown. Idempotent: re-running commit on an unchanged workspace reports zero new entries.

action.description: "commit": register translated units into the TM. "optimize": recompute TM entry weights.

path.description: Optional target file or directory to scope a commit. Omit to process all translation pairs. Ignored for optimize.

languageModelTools.name: mdait_validate
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Validate translated units in mdait-managed documents. Read-only, uses no AI, and requires no confirmation, so it is free to call repeatedly inside a translate->validate->fix loop. checks:"structure" compares Markdown structure (headings/lists/code blocks/tables/links/images) between source and target; checks:"terms" mechanically verifies that when a glossary term appears in the source unit, one of its expected target terms (term + variants) appears in the target unit (code blocks and inline code are excluded; conservative matching to avoid false positives). Only fully translated units (from link present, no need flags) are validated. Returns a JSON envelope { schemaVersion, ok, summary, data, nextActions } where data.violations lists { file, unitHash, check, term?, expected?, severity, message }. Violations are warnings, never auto-fixed: for terms violations decide per case whether to fix the translation or add the deviation to the glossary variants.

path.description: Optional target file or directory to scope the validation. Omit to validate all translation pairs.

checks.description: Which checks to run. Omit to run both structure and terms.

languageModelTools.name: mdait_aiReview
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Triage adopted translation pairs with AI. For every target unit flagged need:review (created by mdait_sync with adopt:true), an LLM judges whether the target is a faithful and complete translation of its linked source unit. Verdicts: match (auto-removes need:review when confidence is at or above a fixed high-confidence threshold and there are no issues), partial (incomplete translation - kept as need:review and escalated), mismatch (suspected wrong pairing - kept and escalated), uncertain (kept). Pass mode:"audit" to also verify already-confirmed pairs (from present, no need flag) as a health check: pairs that no longer look faithful/complete (adopted mis-pairing or hand-edited degradation) are REPORTED ONLY as 'flagged' - their markers are NOT changed - and healthy pairs are counted as 'audited'. (Source revisions are already caught deterministically by mdait_sync as need:revise and are excluded from the audit.) The default mode:"pending" reviews only need:review units. Returns a JSON envelope { schemaVersion, ok, summary, data, nextActions } where data contains per-verdict unit counts (including flagged/audited) and an escalations list (file, unitHash, title, verdict, confidence, reason, issues) that lists both escalated and flagged units. Idempotent: approved units are not re-verified on the next pending run. Pass dryRun:true to get the report without changing any markers. Uses AI and may rewrite markers (need:review triage), so a confirmation is shown.

path.description: Optional target file or directory to scope the review. Omit to review all translation pairs.

dryRun.description: If true, only report verdicts without changing any markers.

mode.description: Review scope. 'pending' (default) verifies only need:review units. 'audit' also verifies confirmed pairs (from present, no need flag) as a health check; unfaithful/incomplete confirmed pairs are reported only ('flagged'), their markers are not changed.

languageModelTools.name: mdait_aiSync
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Composite onboarding-and-audit command that runs three mdait steps in order over the whole workspace: (1) sync with adopt+align (adopts marker-less existing translations as need:review and uses an LLM to correct position-based unit mis-pairings), (2) AI pairing review of every adopted pair (auto-removes need:review from high-confidence faithful translations, escalates suspected mis-pairings/incomplete translations). Not onboarding-only: on an already-managed site the align step is a no-op (all units are from-anchored) and only the review runs, so this doubles as a health-audit button. Returns a JSON envelope { schemaVersion, ok, summary, data, nextActions } where data contains the sync counts (adopted/alignCorrections/added/deleted/kept), the per-verdict review counts, an escalations list, and the post-run status. Idempotent: re-running on a clean workspace reports zero adoptions, zero corrections, and zero units to review. Pass dryRun:true to skip marker changes in the review step (adopt still updates markers). Uses AI and rewrites markers, so a confirmation is shown.

dryRun.description: If true, the AI pairing review step reports verdicts without changing markers; the adopt step still updates markers.
